title: Password policy has no common-password check and MFA is unavailable
expected: Passwords are checked against a list of common/breached passwords; MFA (TOTP or passkeys) is available at L2, at least for business owners and admins; OTP hashing secret is mandatory in production.
actual: Only length 8–128 is enforced. The two_factor_auth flag is off and no MFA flow is exposed. OTP_SALT is optional in production (index.ts treats it as non-fatal; hashOtp falls back to an empty salt).
impact: Account takeover via common passwords is easier, and business owners/admins who control payment details have no second factor.
fix: Reject the top ~10k common passwords (bundled list) and optionally check k-anonymity breach APIs; ship TOTP (and later passkeys) behind two_factor_auth, required for admins; refuse to start in production without OTP_SALT.
